parsed.rationale: One participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ path — a sample-app restraint marker that dominates action signals per the decision rules. A second record lives at 'Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/MP3StreamDecoderTests.swift', a test-target path that constitutes an additional restraint. Beyond the restraint markers, the eight members span four unrelated packages (Playback, DebugPanel, Wallpaper, Intents) with entirely empty fields_or_signature lists and only a shared_field_count of 1 with no named shared members, providing insufficient structural evidence to justify a cross-package extraction even if the restraint markers were absent. Lifting the production extensions into a shared package would couple production code to sample-app and test semantics.
